description_en: Queries the patch list of a cloud application
description_zh: 查询一个云应用的Patch列表
name: ListCloudAppPatches

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud application, which corresponds to a unique application package
parameters.help_zh: 云应用ID，对应唯一的应用包
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The page number of the list to query. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
查询列表的页码。起始值为1。
默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值为100行。
默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The start time of the time range filter. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 时间区间筛选参数。按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The start time of the time range filter. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 时间区间筛选参数。按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: end_time

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned list

PageSize.description_en: Settings for the number of entries per page when paging in a paged query
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数
PageSize.title_en: 分页查询时设置的每页行数。
PageSize.title_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数。

Patches.description_en: The patch list of the cloud application

items.description_en: The patch information of the cloud application

PostCommandPath.description_en: The relative path of the post-command in the application package. This parameter is supported only for Windows applications
PostCommandPath.description_zh: 后置命令在应用包内的相对路径，仅支持 win 类型应用
PostCommandPath.title_en: 后置命令在应用包内的相对路径，仅支持 win 类型应用。
PostCommandPath.title_zh: 后置命令在应用包内的相对路径，仅支持 win 类型应用。

PostCommandTimeoutSec.description_en: The timeout period for executing the post-command, in seconds. This parameter is supported only for Windows applications
PostCommandTimeoutSec.description_zh: 后置命令执行超时时间(秒)，仅支持 win 类型应用
PostCommandTimeoutSec.title_en: 后置命令执行超时时间(秒)，仅支持 win 类型应用。
PostCommandTimeoutSec.title_zh: 后置命令执行超时时间(秒)，仅支持 win 类型应用。

Created
Doing
Success: desired state
Failed: desired state
Deleting
DeleteFailed: desired state

UpdateTime.description_zh: 状态最新更新时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss

UploadTime.description_en: The time when the application was uploaded. The time is in the ISO 8601 standard and includes the time zone offset, in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss+HH:mm format
UploadTime.description_zh: 上传时间，采用 ISO 8601 标准并包含时区偏移，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss+HH:mm
